title: farmstead child
description: Grew up between rows of barley on a fallen-world farm, where every hand counted after the Hush.

title: mining town kid
description: Raised in a company town under a dead moon, breathing rock dust and learning which tunnels not to enter.

title: freighter-born
description: Born in the cold decks of a sleeper freighter and woken only for the watch rotations; never touched soil until grown.

title: back-alley scrapper
description: Fought for scraps in the lanes of a sprawl world's undercity, and learned to read a crowd before a face.

title: archive reader
description: Spent childhood in a half-powered archive, reading what the Lattice left behind and what little the Hush spared.

title: hunter's child
description: Followed a trapper parent across the ridge lines, learning to carry a rifle before a full pack.

title: canteen helper
description: Peeled roots and stirred pots in a settlement canteen that fed three hundred on a bad harvest.

title: junk tinkerer
description: Took apart every broken relay panel in the settlement scrapyard and sometimes got one working.

title: pampered heir
description: Grew up in a Concord-friendly household where servants did the lifting and tutors did the talking.

title: refugee camp aide
description: Ran bandages and water through a refugee camp when a plague ship docked; learned fast or lost people.

title: military cadet
description: Drilled from dawn in a free-hold cadet school, taught that a steady hand is worth more than a sharp tongue.

title: wall painter
description: Painted murals on shelter walls for a few coins and a warm meal, and never stopped.

title: builder's apprentice
description: Hauled planks and mixed mortar for a settlement crew that rebuilt after every storm.

title: caravan child
description: Rode in a trading caravan between fallen-world towns, minding the beasts and learning who to haggle with.

title: frontier settler
description: Left a crowded orbital for the frontier, planted a first crop, raised a first roof, and stayed.

title: asteroid miner
description: Spent a working life cutting ore on a dead asteroid, with a drill for company and silence for the rest.

title: ship engineer
description: Kept a sleeper freighter's drives alive for two decades of crossings, patching what could not be replaced.

title: frontline trooper
description: Served a free hold's militia through three border wars and came home to find home had moved.

title: hired gun
description: Hired out to whoever paid, from clan feuds to Compact escort jobs, and kept the receipts.

title: galley cook
description: Fed a freighter's crew through lean decades with ration packs, a spice cabinet and some stubborn pride.

title: field surgeon
description: Worked a field clinic on a plague world, carrying the one working scanner from bed to bed.

title: lab researcher
description: Combed Lattice ruins for readable cores, trusting data over everyone, including the Sleepers.

title: hydroponics farmer
description: Ran the hydroponic racks on a lumen-world relay station, and sulked at open soil.

title: herd rancher
description: Herded hardy beasts across a fallen world's high pastures, with a rifle ready for the wolves.

title: habitat builder
description: Raised habitat domes and hab-spines for a Compact charter company, never the same blueprint twice.

title: orbital trader
description: Worked the orbital markets of a fray world, swapping salvage for promises and promises for salvage.

title: holo-sculptor
description: Sculpted light in a gallery that outlasted its patrons, and still can't see the point of a fight.

title: cargo smuggler
description: Ran sealed crates between ports that disagreed about the law, and talked their way out of the inspections.

title: wreck scavenger
description: Cut metal from wrecks on a battlefield moon, and knew the bones of old machines better than the new.

title: bounty hunter
description: Tracked marks across three systems for the bounty and had little patience for chores.

title: colony teacher
description: Taught reading, sums and manners to a settlement's children until the school lost its funding.

title: dock laborer
description: Loaded and unloaded freight for a dock gang, strong in the back and not asked what he thought.

title: clan-raised child
description: Grew up in a clan camp where every child learns the herd, the spear and the saga before the age of ten.

title: hut apprentice
description: Fetched herbs and kept the fire for a clan shaman who talked to the dreaming ground.

title: relay courier
description: Ran messages between towns that lost the Lattice and no longer trusted a signal.

title: raider camp orphan
description: Raised in a pirate camp where kindness was a rumour and every meal had to be won.

title: sprawl world kid
description: Never saw open sky until grown; learned wiring, haggling and quiet in a stacked city.

title: high pasture child
description: Minded flocks at the end of the valley alone from the age of eight.

title: temple chorister
description: Sang in a hill temple whose gods were mostly old maintenance routines.

title: garage child
description: Grew up under the belly of vehicles that should have been scrap long ago.

title: border scout child
description: Carried messages across contested ground and learned to be quiet and unnoticed.

title: Concord noble child
description: Raised to rule on a Concord world, and to leave heavy things to other hands.

title: orchard child
description: Climbed fruit trees and pickled the harvest in a sheltered valley community.

title: smith's apprentice
description: Pumped bellows in a village forge, where the heat and the hammering shaped a patient child.

title: clinic runner
description: Ran supplies between clinic cots and learned to hold still when others could not.

title: pit ring kid
description: Fought for coins in an underground ring before they could shave.

title: shuttle pilot
description: Flew shuttles between a sleeper hull and a hundred small ports, always one fuel check from disaster.

title: port guard
description: Held a gate at a Compact port and learned that most trouble sorts itself out if you stand tall.

title: pirate captain
description: Led a pirate fleet by threat and charm; fell out with every partner eventually.

title: roadside brigand
description: Took what travellers carried on the fallen-world roads, and called it a toll.

title: slave taker
description: Made a living selling people to the highest bidder, and a worse one when the buyers lost interest.

title: road tinkerer
description: Travelled between villages repairing pumps, relays and reapers in exchange for meals and whispers.

title: still master
description: Brewed flower wine and mean spirits for half a province, and tasted every batch.

title: hedge herbalist
description: Mixed poultices and tisanes in a hilltop hut, and taught the valley the names of useful plants.

title: river fisher
description: Worked nets on a fallen-world river and gutted the catch before dawn.

title: claim prospector
description: Chased veins from system to system on a promise and a pocket of dust.

title: relay archivist
description: Sat in the dead hall of a Lattice relay for thirty years, cataloguing silence.

title: spire watcher
description: Kept vigil over a Black Spire for a brotherhood that never explained why.

title: clan shaman
description: Spoke for the clan to the dreaming ground, treated its sick, and was never allowed to carry a blade.

title: pit champion
description: Won the pit for six seasons, which is five more than most.

title: mountain hermit
description: Lived alone above the tree line until the avalanche season sent them down.

title: estate gardener
description: Kept a hundred beds in bloom for an estate whose owners barely visited.

title: hull welder
description: Sealed hull plates in a drydock while the stars turned, all day, every day.

title: Compact clerk
description: Counted bags of grain and copies of treaties in a Compact tax house for twenty years.

title: abattoir hand
description: Worked a processing line where one learns what a body is made of.

title: long-range marksman
description: Sold their patience and their eyes to those who could not afford to miss.

title: medical corpsman
description: Followed troops into three campaigns with a med-kit and a short-barrelled carbine.

title: far-trader's hand
description: Drove pack animals in a far-trader's string across half a continent, one market at a time.

title: rooftop sentry
description: Stood night watch on a settlement wall for ten winters; nothing ever came, until it did.

title: roadside healer
description: Sold tonics and verdicts to frightened villagers; occasionally one worked.

title: relay technician
description: Kept an ageing relay station powered long after anyone answered the signals.

title: kiln keeper
description: Fired bricks and pots in a kiln village, and watched flames like others watch the sea.
